title: Designing AI-Agents with Personalities: A Psychometric Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing AI-agent responses on moral dilemma vignettes (e.g., underage drinking, exam cheating, confidential information) to human baselines, demonstrating that newer, safety-aligned models consistently skew towards overly moral and socially acceptable responses, often overriding their assigned personality traits.

Evaluating and comparing standard numeric Likert scale prompts against expanded sentence-format prompts to determine how representational indirectness and prompt formatting affect the reliability, factor structure, and validity of the AI's psychometric responses.
